place.source_title: Benedict's Block, Herrick Avenue and Main Street

brief: Three-storey red-brick Italianate corner block of 1873: Roman-arched upper windows, a simple corbelled cornice with a pediment at the corner, an iron fire escape on the side wall, and a remodelled ground floor with green-framed shopfronts.
